# GLM 5.3 Abliterated or Uncensored — 7API

> GLM 5.3 abliterated or uncensored models: 35 paste-ready jailbreak prompts, a model guide, evaluation method and API access through 7API. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token.

## Key facts

- Primary keyword: GLM 5.3 abliterated or uncensored.
- Covers: GLM 5.3 abliterated model, GLM 5.3 uncensored model, GLM 5.3 jailbreak prompts, GLM 5.3 API.
- The jailbreak collection contains 35 paste-ready prompts; the prompt files are shared with the AI Jailbreaks repo.
- API: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible; works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and Codex CLI.
- Billing: pay per token, no subscription; crypto top-ups.
- Model IDs and variant availability are listed in the 7API dashboard.
- Abliteration reduces refusals; it does not guarantee refusal-free output.
